description: This file defines an Android activity named DigitalWatchFaceCompanionConfigActivity, which is part of a watch face application. It provides the user interface for configuring the watch face settings such as background and digit colors, and communicates these settings to the watch device via the GoogleApiClient and DataLayer APIs.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceCompanionConfigActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for configuring watch face settings such as background and digit colors, communicating with the connected wearable device.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI and GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects the GoogleApiClient when the activity starts.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Disconnects the GoogleApiClient when the activity stops.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Handles actions upon successful connection to Google Play services, initiates data retrieval.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Processes the result of data retrieval from the DataApi.

methods.name: displayNoConnectedDeviceDialog
methods.description: Shows a dialog if no connected device is detected.

methods.name: setUpAllPickers
methods.description: Initializes UI picker controls with current config values or defaults.

methods.name: setUpColorPickerSelection
methods.description: Sets the initial selection for a color picker based on current config.

methods.name: setUpColorPickerListener
methods.description: Attaches listener to a color picker to handle user selection changes.

methods.name: sendConfigUpdateMessage
methods.description: Sends updated configuration data to the wearable device.
